title: Gladiator — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Gladiator.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Garage Tough." Value tier. Gladiator by Whirlpool is the garage organization brand — heavy-duty cabinets, workbenches, refrigerators, and freezers designed for garage environments. Garage-ready appliances that work in extreme temperatures.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Garage organization. Garage refrigerators and freezers that work in cold temperatures.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Gladiator:

• Garage-ready — works in temperatures from 38 to 110 degrees F

• Heavy-duty storage and organization system

• Whirlpool quality for the garage

• Modular system grows with your needs

• Garage freezers and fridges that actually work in winter
